description: Use named functions and ranges for start balances and loan receipts/disbursements in both loan sheets following the performance comparison.
status: Applied and verified in the original financial plan.
scope: Nine start-balance rows and seven In Loans received anchors updated. The two Out Loans disbursement anchors already used named functions and are unchanged. No Apps Script changes.

changes.reason: Use named current-loan input lookups and timeline for loans received

after.anchorFormula:
=LET(
  loan_name, IN_LOAN_COL_VALUE("Name"),
  loan_date, LOOKUP_BY_NAME(S_IN_LOANS, "Date", "Name", loan_name),
  loan_amount, LOOKUP_BY_NAME(S_IN_LOANS, "Amount", "Name", loan_name),
  ARRAYFORMULA(
    IF(R_MONTHS = IF(loan_date = "", "", MONTH_START(loan_date)), loan_amount, 0)
  )
)
